frame: mount is cart base_link <- the URDF's base_link (origin on the arm base's bottom face, 3.9 cm behind the shoulder_pan axis; +x is where the arm reaches at its zero pose); links are boxes in each link's own URDF frame, metres and degrees (rpy as URDF writes it)

mount.note: FITTED to the head's own depth, not taped (scratch/arm_mount/). Data: scratch/body_fit's two captures of 2026-10-02 23:46-00:02 (7 head poses x 8 depth frames, base_link by TF), the arm parked as read at 23:20 (shoulder_pan -27.6, wrist_roll 10.2), as 5 mm voxels hit and seen free. Position: the folded arm's boxes fitted to the arm's 2989 voxels (z > 0.83 m, right of the speaker box: inside the boxes grown 1 cm, minus 0.5 x the seen-free voxels inside the boxes shrunk 1 cm). HEADING from the arm's own top, not from that score: the top (z > 0.895, forearm and wrist, seen whole from pan -90) heads -3.8 / -4.7 deg in the two captures (per frame +-1.5), and the model's visible top from the same camera matches it at yaw -31.3..-33.8 (cuts 0.91..0.88): -33.0. The score alone (2026-10-04 first fit: yaw -18.8) turns the model 15 deg counter-clockwise, pulled by ~400 voxels at the arm's front-left (x 0..0.08, y -0.06..-0.10, z 0.84-0.91: the servo cable loops) that only the wrist and gripper boxes can reach; freeing wrist_roll or the pan zero does not change it. Check by the re-pose of 2026-10-04 03:20: the arm turned counter-clockwise by the pan alone (reading -6.7, the base untouched) and looks parallel to the cart's side wall; this mount puts the model's top at -3.5 deg before and +3.0 after (the -18.8 fit: +10.7 and +17.4); projected into run2's snap_m90_t63 the boxes run along the arm. Residual (2026-10-02 data): of the arm's voxels 98.0 % within margin_m, 74 % within 1 cm, outside distance rms 11.4 mm (p90 22, p99 33 mm: the cable loops); 15 % of the shrunk boxes seen free. Uncertainty: x +-8 mm, y +-10 mm, z +-8 mm (the two captures 1/2/1 mm apart at this yaw; weights, tolerances and the height cut -6..+3 / -5..+5 / -4..+8 mm), yaw +-4 deg (the cut +-1.5, the eye's yaw calibration +-3). The pan axis sits at (-0.024, -0.144), the base's bottom face 0.78 m up. run2 (2026-10-04 03:30) cannot be fitted: the head did not hold its poses (most frames between home and the target) and the frames that reached one read the speaker box and the rim 2-8 mm median, 8-18 mm p90 off the earlier captures (1 / 3-6 mm between those two). Prior: XLeRobot's right arm (xlerobot_front.urdf: base square to the top basket, pan axis 3.9 cm behind the front wall, 6.1 cm in from the right wall, base bottom 1.5 cm under the rim) on this basket: (-0.065, -0.133, 0.765, 0 deg); pan axis (-0.027, -0.133). YAW CARRIES THE SHOULDER_PAN ZERO (joints-as-read convention): depth cannot tell the base's yaw from the pan's zero. Variant A, as written: the base turned 33 deg clockwise on the cart. Variant B: the base square (yaw_deg 0, x_m -0.062, y_m -0.141, z_m 0.779) and shoulder_pan 33 deg left of its reading (pose_deg -1.3 now: the arm straight on its base), the same top heading (-3.6) and 7 % more score than A (2022 against 1882: the base box, mostly hidden, is the only witness); 33 is more than the ~23 the calibrated range allows inside the URDF's +-110, less than the 40 by which the pan's homing pose (2047 ticks) sits from its range middle (2503.5). Choose B when the base is square to the cart by eye; then the joint publisher adds the same +33.

joints.note: pose_deg is the arm as it stands parked, READ 2026-10-04 03:25 through the base server's registers request (Present_Position of ids 1-6), after Artem re-posed it at 03:20 (turned counter-clockwise by a small angle, the wrist handled); the reading of 2026-10-02 23:20 (scratch/arm_mask/read_arm.py), which the mount's depth fit used, was shoulder_pan -27.6, shoulder_lift -102.6, elbow_flex 96.8, wrist_flex 72.1, wrist_roll 10.2, gripper 4.6: the servos' EEPROM carries the lerobot calibration of 2026-08-30 to the tick (homing offsets and position limits = ~/.cache/huggingface/lerobot/calibration/robots/so_follower/pepin_follower.json), and the URDF's 'new calib' zero is the middle of each calibrated range, lerobot's DEGREES convention: angle = (ticks - (range_min + range_max) / 2) * 360 / 4096. The gripper is lerobot's linear 0-100 joint, here (ticks - range_min) * 360 / 4096 - 10 deg onto the URDF's -10..100. The signs are lerobot's = the URDF's. shoulder_pan's is verified by the re-pose: turned counter-clockwise, it read -6.7, and the URDF's pan axis is the base's -z (origin rpy pi 0 -pi), so a negative step turns it counter-clockwise. The others are NOT verified by a move: with them the parked arm stands folded on its base (scratch/arm_mask/folded_pose.py; shoulder_lift and elbow_flex sit at a stop each, the URDF's limits), with shoulder_lift or elbow_flex flipped it would reach 11 cm under its own base. shoulder_pan's zero is the least sure: its calibrated range is 174 deg against the URDF's 220, so its middle may sit up to ~23 deg off, and the depth fit's top axis wants 33 if the base is square (mount note). source topic reads /arm/joint_states (sensor_msgs/JointState, these joint names, radians, URDF convention, stamped at the encoder read) and falls back to pose_deg when no sample lies within max_age_s of a frame.

links_source: scripts/arm_boxes.py: the tightest box along each link's own axes (or its vertices' principal axes, whichever is smaller; never smaller here), cut in two across the longest side where that saves a quarter of the volume, fitted to the visual meshes of TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 at 5f6d2b8 (Apache-2.0), exact hulls; margin_m grows every box at run time. scripts/arm_boxes.py --check compares this block with the meshes.
note: The robot's own arm for the camera's self-filter (pepin.arm; depth_fusion's arm_filter flag): its links posed by forward kinematics of the vendored URDF (pepin/vendor/so101), every box grown by margin_m; a depth pixel whose ray enters a grown box writes nothing on or past that point, and every voxel inside a grown box is forgotten after each integration. Read live: an edit of this file reaches the next frame. depth_fusion publishes the grown boxes on /fusion/arm (visualization_msgs/MarkerArray, base_link) whether or not the flag is on: the check is the arm's points inside them in Foxglove.
